_note: P10 편집 스펙. 전량 0크레딧 — US6368227 도면·본문 크롭의 블루프린트 반전 + 코드 렌더 카드 4종. 반전은 13·14비트의 이름 짝(OLSON/OLSON) — 변리사가 아버지, 발명자가 일곱 살 아들.
subs_ko:
그네 타는 법,
특허가 될 수 있을까요?

2000년 겨울, 특허청에
서류 한 장이 들어옵니다.

본문 끝엔 이렇게 적혀 있었죠.
'사용권 문의 환영.'

그런데 6주 만에,
특허청이 스스로 다시 엽니다.

그 아들은 낼 때 다섯 살,
나올 때 일곱 살이었고요.
subs_en:
Can a way of swinging
on a swing be patented?

In the winter of 2000,
one filing reached the office.

The title was simply
"Method of Swinging on a Swing."

Not the back-and-forth
kind you know.

You pull alternately on one
chain, then the other.

The swing then moves
side to side.

That's all of it.
Four claims, nothing more.

The patent office
let it through.

The last line reads: licenses
available upon request.

Six weeks later, the office
reopened it on its own.

Older swing patents surfaced,
one after another.

The result was one line:
all claims cancelled.

The attorney who wrote
that filing was his father.

Five when he filed it.
Seven when it issued.
